name: to_datetime_ordering_lt
note: toDateTime instant ordering: Lt(toDateTime(toString(person.properties.signup_date)), toDateTime("2026-01-01 00:00:00")). expected_result is the ClickHouse/instant-ordering answer, which the Rust VM matches and the Python/TS reference VMs now also match. Note both literals use the ClickHouse space-separated form: luxon's fromISO rejects it, so the TS VM used to return a NaN-valued HogDateTime here and could not in fact match — all three now share one date-like grammar (see parse_datetime_to_seconds in rust/common/hogvm/src/stl.rs). See the module-level provenance caveat.
